table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Path B, Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 4 with manual coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's slow stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 Pedal Multiplier (Path B)
table.description: Pedal-based multiplier on Path B's slow-stage rise rate.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Path B, Drive Mode 1, Default)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 1 (the default and fallback mode) with manual coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's fast stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Path B, Drive Mode 2, Sport)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 2 with manual coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's fast stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Path B, Drive Mode 3, Intelligent)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 3 with manual coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's fast stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Path B, Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 4 with manual coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's fast stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 Pedal Multiplier (Path B)
table.description: Pedal-based multiplier on Path B's fast-stage rise rate.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Path B, Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 1 (the default and fallback mode) with AT/CVT coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's slow stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Path B, Drive Mode 2, Sport, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 2 with AT/CVT coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's slow stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Path B, Drive Mode 3, Intelligent, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 3 with AT/CVT coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's slow stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Path B, Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 4 with AT/CVT coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's slow stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Path B, Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 1 (the default and fallback mode) with AT/CVT coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's fast stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Path B, Drive Mode 2, Sport, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 2 with AT/CVT coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's fast stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Path B, Drive Mode 3, Intelligent, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 3 with AT/CVT coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's fast stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Path B, Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 4 with AT/CVT coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's fast stage.

table.name: Rev Limit RPM
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: The rev limit: above it the ECU cuts fuel to all four cylinders on every firing and closes the throttle; spark is not cut or retarded. To move the limit, set this, Rev Limit Full Cut RPM, Rev Limit Full Cut Reset RPM, Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM and Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold) to the new rpm and Rev Limit Reset RPM about 100 lower.

table.name: Rev Limit Reset RPM
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: End of the rev-limit state: the throttle cap stays until rpm falls to this and boost is below Rev Limit Reset Maximum MAP, while fuel already returns at Rev Limit Full Cut Reset RPM. Keep it about 100 rpm below Rev Limit RPM.

table.name: Rev Limit Full Cut RPM
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: At or above this rpm, once the rev limit has started, every injector is cut on every firing (a hard fuel cut). Keep it equal to Rev Limit RPM; set higher, the range between them gets only the throttle cap, probably a softer limit.

table.name: Rev Limit Full Cut Reset RPM
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Fuel returns once rpm falls to this and boost is below Rev Limit Reset Maximum MAP.

table.name: Rev Limit Stage 1 RPM
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Set it to your rev limit with the other Rev Limit rpm values.

table.name: Rev Limit Stage 2 RPM (Stage 1 Hold)
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Stage 1 of the throttle cap holds above this rpm. Set it to your rev limit.

table.name: Rev Limit Reset Maximum MAP
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: The rev-limit fuel cut and state cannot end while manifold pressure is at or above this, even below their reset rpm. Raise it if you want the cut to release on rpm alone at high boost.

table.name: Maximum Torque (IAT)
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Maximum target torque by rpm and intake air temperature. The ECU uses the lowest of this, Maximum Torque (DAM) and other limits, and the result drives the boost target.

table.name: Maximum Torque (DAM)
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Maximum target torque by DAM (knock learning) and rpm, in the same lowest-wins limit as Maximum Torque (IAT). Losing DAM lowers the torque target and so the boost target.

table.name: Overboost Limit
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Overboost limit by rpm, compensated for baro and intake temperature like the boost target. Boost 26.7 kPa over it for 2 s sets the overboost flag, and 33 kPa over it starts the overboost cut (throttle cap, then a full fuel cut once the flag is set). Raise it when raising boost targets. Note: the boost-control pressure reading stops at about 269 kPa absolute, so an Overboost Limit above about 236 kPa absolute (269 minus the 33 kPa cut margin) can never trigger the overboost cut.

table.name: Rev/Boost Limit Torque (Base)
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Throttle-side torque cap by rpm used only during the rev or overboost cut when neither stage applies. It does not limit torque in normal driving, so raising it gives no extra power.

table.name: Rev/Boost Limit Torque (Stage 2)
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Second throttle-side cap of the rev/overboost cut.

table.name: Rev/Boost Limit Torque (Stage 1)
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Throttle-side torque cap while the rev limiter is cutting fuel, or during an overboost cut above 256 kPa absolute: the throttle closes toward it.

table.name: Rev/Boost Limit Torque Stage 1 MAP
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: During a rev or overboost cut, manifold pressure above which the stage 1 throttle cap is used. It does not start a cut by itself.

table.name: Rev/Boost Limit Torque Stage 1 Reset MAP
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Stage 1 throttle cap stays on while manifold pressure is above this.

table.name: Rev/Boost Limit Torque Stage 2 Hold MAP
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Stage 2 throttle cap stays on while manifold pressure is above this.

table.name: Rev/Boost Limit Torque Caps Enable [byte, bit 0 = 1]
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Bit 0 of this byte (value 1) is the switch: add 1 to set it, subtract 1 to clear it; leave the other bits as they are. Lets the rev limiter and overboost cut close the throttle (the Rev/Boost Limit Torque tables). Bit 0 (value 1).

table.name: Overboost Margin
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: How far above Overboost Limit boost must be before overboost time is counted toward the overboost flag, which makes the overboost cut a full fuel cut.

table.name: Overboost Delay
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: How long boost must stay above Overboost Limit plus Overboost Margin before the overboost flag sets and the overboost cut becomes a full fuel cut.

table.name: Overboost Flag Reset Margin
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Once set, the overboost flag clears only when boost falls to Overboost Limit plus this.

table.name: Overboost Cut Margin (Limit State)
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Boost above Overboost Limit plus this enters the overboost cut state: the throttle is capped at once, and fuel to all cylinders is cut only if the 2-second overboost flag is also set.

table.name: Overboost Cut Hysteresis (Limit State)
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: How far boost must fall below the overboost cut level before the overboost cut state ends.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Vehicle speed limiter. It needs this speed, Vehicle Speed Limit Minimum RPM and Vehicle Speed Limit Full Cut Speed to act, and then cuts fuel to all cylinders without closing the throttle.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit Minimum RPM
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: The speed limiter only starts at or above this engine speed.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit Full Cut Speed
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Speed at which the active speed limiter cuts fuel to all cylinders; without it the limiter does nothing.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit Full Cut Speed Hysteresis
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: How far speed must fall below Vehicle Speed Limit Full Cut Speed before the fuel cut ends.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit Offset
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Subtracted from Vehicle Speed Limit to give the speed where the limiter state starts; it is not a release hysteresis.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit Reset Maximum MAP
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: The speed limiter cannot release while manifold pressure is above this.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit Reset Maximum MAP Hysteresis
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Hysteresis on Vehicle Speed Limit Reset Maximum MAP.

table.name: Rev Limit Full Cut Speed Threshold
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Vehicle speed above which the rev-limit fuel cut uses the Stage 1 / Stage 2 rpm values instead of the Full Cut pair.

table.name: Rev Limit Full Cut Speed Threshold Hysteresis
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Extra speed needed above Rev Limit Full Cut Speed Threshold before the switch.

table.name: Fail-Safe Rev Limit (Rail Pressure Fault)
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Rev limit used only while a fuel-rail pressure fault is active: above it fuel to all cylinders is cut.

table.name: Fail-Safe Rev Limit (Injector Driver Fault)
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Rev limit used only while an injector-driver fault has put the fuel system in its low-pressure fail-safe: above it fuel to all cylinders is cut.

table.name: Fail-Safe Rev Limit (Unused Fault Flag)
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Details: When used: only while FFF88F4A bit 2 is set. Otherwise as Fail-Safe Rev Limit (Rail Pressure Fault) (0x0C1AC8, read). Precisely (0x0C1AC8, read): while the fail-safe comparator FFF841F9 is set the count is cal 0x38248, not a literal 4; and it is overridden when FFF89BFE bit 2 is set (the count then comes from cals 0x23D58-0x23D5F, not yet defined). Confidence: read.

table.name: Fail-Safe Rev Limit Hysteresis
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: How far rpm must fall below an active fail-safe rev limit before fuel returns.

table.name: Fail-Safe Rev Limit Minimum Above Idle Target
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: A fail-safe rev limit is never set lower than the idle target plus this.

table.name: Limit-State Spark: Normal Target in Speed Limit [byte, bit 6 = 64]
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Bit 6 of this byte (value 64) is the switch: add 64 to set it, subtract 64 to clear it; leave the other bits as they are. Keeps normal spark timing during the vehicle-speed limiter. Bit 6 (value 64).

table.name: Limit-State Spark: Normal Target in Rev/Overboost Cut [byte, bit 7 = 128]
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Bit 7 of this byte (value 128) is the switch: add 128 to set it, subtract 128 to clear it; leave the other bits as they are. Keeps normal spark timing during the rev limiter and overboost cut instead of retarding it. Bit 7 (value 128).

table.name: External Torque Limit Baro Factor
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Air-density correction (barometric part) applied to a torque limit received over CAN, probably from the transmission controller.

table.name: External Torque Limit IAT Factor
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Air-density correction (intake temperature part) applied to a torque limit received over CAN, probably from the transmission controller.

table.name: Cylinder Cut Torque Ratio (1 Cylinder)
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: When a cut state asks for less torque than this share of the engine's current torque, one cylinder in four is cut. Also sets the first decel fuel cut stage.

table.name: Cylinder Cut Torque Ratio (2 Cylinders)
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Below this share of current torque, two cylinders in four are cut. Also sets the second decel fuel cut stage.

table.name: Cylinder Cut Torque Ratio (3 Cylinders)
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Below this share of current torque, three cylinders in four are cut. Also sets the third decel fuel cut stage.

table.name: Cylinder Cut Torque Ratio (4 Cylinders)
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Below this share of current torque all cylinders are cut. The rev limiter asks for zero torque, so it always cuts all four.

table.name: Cylinder Cut Torque Ratio Hysteresis
table.category: 04.02 Torque & Throttle - Torque Limits & Engine Protection
table.description: Hysteresis on the cylinder-cut torque ratios and decel cut stages.

table.name: Throttle Opening Map Reference Torque
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Torque by rpm that counts as 100 % in the Throttle Opening from Target Torque maps: at or above it they give wide-open throttle. Raise it together with Full-Load Reference Brake Torque for a higher-torque tune. Edit together with Throttle Opening Map Reference Torque (Monitor).

table.name: Throttle Opening Map Reference Torque (Monitor)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Throttle-monitor copy of Throttle Opening Map Reference Torque. Keep identical to the main table, or expect the monitor to disagree with the main path (plausibility fault inferred).

table.name: Throttle Opening from Target Torque (TGV Closed)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: This is where part-throttle feel is set: the commanded throttle opening is essentially this map (by rpm and target torque) plus the idle air. Used with the TGVs closed and no EGR (blended by TGV position and EGR amount). Edit together with Throttle Opening from Target Torque (TGV Closed, Monitor).

table.name: Throttle Opening from Target Torque (TGV Closed, Monitor)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Throttle-monitor copy of Throttle Opening from Target Torque (TGV Closed). Make the same edit here as on the main table, or expect a plausibility fault (inferred).

table.name: Throttle Opening from Target Torque (TGV Open)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: This is where part-throttle feel is set: the commanded throttle opening is essentially this map (by rpm and target torque) plus the idle air. Used with the TGVs open and no EGR; probably the table a warm car mostly uses at part load. Edit together with Throttle Opening from Target Torque (TGV Open, Monitor).

table.name: Throttle Opening from Target Torque (TGV Open, Monitor)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Throttle-monitor copy of Throttle Opening from Target Torque (TGV Open). Make the same edit here as on the main table, or expect a plausibility fault (inferred).

table.name: Throttle Opening from Target Torque (TGV Closed, EGR)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: This is where part-throttle feel is set: the commanded throttle opening is essentially this map (by rpm and target torque) plus the idle air. Used with the TGVs closed and EGR active (blended by TGV position and EGR amount). Edit together with Throttle Opening from Target Torque (TGV Closed, EGR, Monitor).

table.name: Throttle Opening from Target Torque (TGV Closed, EGR, Monitor)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Throttle-monitor copy of Throttle Opening from Target Torque (TGV Closed, EGR). Make the same edit here as on the main table, or expect a plausibility fault (inferred).

table.name: Throttle Opening from Target Torque (TGV Open, EGR)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: This is where part-throttle feel is set: the commanded throttle opening is essentially this map (by rpm and target torque) plus the idle air. Used with the TGVs open and EGR active (blended by TGV position and EGR amount). Edit together with Throttle Opening from Target Torque (TGV Open, EGR, Monitor).

table.name: Throttle Opening from Target Torque (TGV Open, EGR, Monitor)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Throttle-monitor copy of Throttle Opening from Target Torque (TGV Open, EGR). Make the same edit here as on the main table, or expect a plausibility fault (inferred).

table.name: Throttle Opening from Target Torque (Cruise, TGV Closed)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: This is where part-throttle feel is set: the commanded throttle opening is essentially this map (by rpm and target torque) plus the idle air. Probably used while cruise control is active; TGVs closed, no EGR. Edit together with Throttle Opening from Target Torque (Cruise, TGV Closed, Monitor).

table.name: Throttle Opening from Target Torque (Cruise, TGV Closed, Monitor)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Throttle-monitor copy of Throttle Opening from Target Torque (Cruise, TGV Closed). Make the same edit here as on the main table, or expect a plausibility fault (inferred).

table.name: Throttle Opening from Target Torque (Cruise, TGV Closed, EGR)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: This is where part-throttle feel is set: the commanded throttle opening is essentially this map (by rpm and target torque) plus the idle air. Probably used while cruise control is active; TGVs closed, EGR active. Edit together with Throttle Opening from Target Torque (Cruise, TGV Closed, EGR, Monitor).

table.name: Throttle Opening from Target Torque (Cruise, TGV Closed, EGR, Monitor)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Throttle-monitor copy of Throttle Opening from Target Torque (Cruise, TGV Closed, EGR). Make the same edit here as on the main table, or expect a plausibility fault (inferred).

table.name: Throttle Opening from Target Torque (Cruise, TGV Open)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: This is where part-throttle feel is set: the commanded throttle opening is essentially this map (by rpm and target torque) plus the idle air. Probably used while cruise control is active; TGVs open, no EGR. Edit together with Throttle Opening from Target Torque (Cruise, TGV Open, Monitor).

table.name: Throttle Opening from Target Torque (Cruise, TGV Open, Monitor)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Throttle-monitor copy of Throttle Opening from Target Torque (Cruise, TGV Open). Make the same edit here as on the main table, or expect a plausibility fault (inferred).

table.name: Throttle Opening from Target Torque (Cruise, TGV Open, EGR)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: This is where part-throttle feel is set: the commanded throttle opening is essentially this map (by rpm and target torque) plus the idle air. Probably used while cruise control is active; TGVs open, EGR active. Edit together with Throttle Opening from Target Torque (Cruise, TGV Open, EGR, Monitor).

table.name: Throttle Opening from Target Torque (Cruise, TGV Open, EGR, Monitor)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Throttle-monitor copy of Throttle Opening from Target Torque (Cruise, TGV Open, EGR). Make the same edit here as on the main table, or expect a plausibility fault (inferred).

table.name: Throttle Opening (Required Area)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Converts the required throttle area into commanded throttle opening (%). It is the exact inverse of Throttle Area from Opening; keep the two consistent, and edit Throttle Opening (Monitor) too. Leave alone unless the throttle body changes. Area is in mm^2 of effective throttle opening (about 2,150 mm^2 wide open).

table.name: Throttle Opening (Monitor)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Throttle-monitor copy of Throttle Opening (Required Area). Area is in mm^2 of effective throttle opening (about 2,150 mm^2 wide open).

table.name: Throttle Required Area
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Throttle area needed for a given fraction of full-load torque, by rpm. At part throttle it cancels out against Torque Fraction from Throttle Area, so part-throttle feel is set by the Throttle Opening from Target Torque maps instead. If you edit it, edit it with Torque Fraction from Throttle Area and Throttle Required Area (Monitor). Area is in mm^2 of effective throttle opening (about 2,150 mm^2 wide open).

table.name: Throttle Required Area (Monitor)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Throttle-monitor copy of Throttle Required Area. Area is in mm^2 of effective throttle opening (about 2,150 mm^2 wide open).

table.name: Throttle Area from Opening
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Converts a throttle opening (%) into throttle area; the exact inverse of Throttle Opening (Required Area). Also gives the required area during cranking. Keep the two consistent; leave alone unless the throttle body changes. Area is in mm^2 of effective throttle opening (about 2,150 mm^2 wide open).

table.name: Throttle Area from Opening (Monitor)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Throttle-monitor copy of Throttle Area from Opening. Keep it identical to the main table (and the inverse of Throttle Opening), or expect a plausibility fault (inferred). Area is in mm^2 of effective throttle opening (about 2,150 mm^2 wide open).

table.name: Torque Fraction from Throttle Area
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Fraction of full-load torque expected from a given throttle area, by rpm; used to build the throttle torque request. The inverse of Throttle Required Area: if you edit one, edit the other, and Torque Fraction from Throttle Area (Monitor). Area is in mm^2 of effective throttle opening (about 2,150 mm^2 wide open).

table.name: Torque Fraction from Throttle Area (Monitor)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Throttle-monitor copy of Torque Fraction from Throttle Area. Keep identical, or expect a plausibility fault (inferred). Area is in mm^2 of effective throttle opening (about 2,150 mm^2 wide open).

table.name: Idle Air Request Limit (Coolant)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Upper limit, by coolant temperature, on the idle air request (probably from idle speed control) before it is converted to throttle area.

table.name: Idle Air Request to Throttle Area
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Converts the idle air request into throttle area, which is added to the pedal-driven opening and sets the idle throttle floor. Edit together with Idle Air Request to Throttle Area (Monitor). Area is in mm^2 of effective throttle opening (about 2,150 mm^2 wide open).

table.name: Idle Air Request to Throttle Area (Monitor)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Throttle-monitor copy of Idle Air Request to Throttle Area. Keep identical, or expect a plausibility fault (inferred). Area is in mm^2 of effective throttle opening (about 2,150 mm^2 wide open).

table.name: Start Throttle Opening Add (Coolant)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Extra throttle opening during engine start (cranking, car stopped), by coolant temperature. Edit together with Start Throttle Opening Add (Monitor).

table.name: Start Throttle Opening Add (Monitor)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Throttle-monitor copy of Start Throttle Opening Add (Coolant).

table.name: Throttle Torque Request Cap
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Cap on the torque request (plus engine losses) that the throttle model works from. Raise it for high-torque tunes.

table.name: Throttle Limit (Rail Pressure Deviation)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description:
Throttle opening cap by rpm for a rail-pressure-deviation fault mode.
Details: 0x0C4E5C (read): AFBA = min(this(rpm), T) while FFF8A9C9 bit 2 is set; 0x1296A8 sets it when rail pressure FFF88884 exceeds FFF8B9A0 by cal 0x38B00 for 05DA3C(rpm) passes, only if cal 0x38AD4 bit 0 - which is 0. Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). p16 (read): 0x1296A8 (<- 0x1289AC <- 0x1E0AE8) counts 20 ms passes. Confidence: read.

table.name: Throttle Limit (Fuel Pressure Fault)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Limp-mode throttle cap by rpm while a fuel pressure fault (P0087, P0088, P0192/P0193 and related codes) is pending; probably meant to limit speed with a high-pressure fuel fault.

table.name: Throttle Limit (Injector Circuit Fault)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Limp-mode throttle cap by rpm while an injector or injector-driver fault (P1261-P1264, P2146, P062D) is set.

table.name: Throttle Offset Step IAT Factor
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Intake-temperature factor on the step rate of a small throttle offset ramp.

table.name: Throttle Offset Step Baro Factor
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Barometric factor on the step rate of a small throttle offset ramp.

table.name: Throttle Offset Limit IAT Factor
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Intake-temperature factor on the lower limit of a small throttle offset ramp.

table.name: Throttle Offset Limit Baro Factor
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Barometric factor on the lower limit of a small throttle offset ramp.

table.name: Throttle Offset RPM Threshold (Coolant)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Engine speed, by coolant temperature, below which a throttle offset ramp acts (probably a cold / low-speed throttle offset).

table.name: Throttle Air Spark Compensation Limit
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Caps, by actual ignition timing, how much the throttle model may add air to make up for retarded timing. Shares data with two other entries: editing one edits all three.

table.name: Throttle Limit (Unused Mode)
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Highest-priority throttle cap by rpm for a fault mode that nothing in this ROM ever sets, so it has no effect.

table.name: Throttle Command Rate Term
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model

table.name: Y Axis
table.scaling: % per pass (change of throttle command FFF8AF84 unit) uint16

table.description: Has no effect: the ECU calculates a value from it that nothing reads.

table.name: Throttle Command Term
table.category: 04.03 Torque & Throttle - Throttle Control & Throttle Model
table.description: Has no effect: the ECU calculates a value from it that nothing reads.

table.name: Engine Torque from Load (DAM 1.0, TGV Closed)
table.description: Engine torque the ECU expects at a given rpm and load; probably shapes the estimated/reported torque, not throttle or boost. This is the full-DAM set, for TGVs closed, no EGR (blended by TGV position and EGR amount).

table.name: Engine Torque from Load (DAM 1.0, TGV Closed, EGR)
table.description: Engine torque the ECU expects at a given rpm and load; probably shapes the estimated/reported torque, not throttle or boost. This is the full-DAM set, for TGVs closed, EGR active (blended by TGV position and EGR amount).

table.name: Engine Torque from Load (DAM 1.0, TGV Open)
table.description: Engine torque the ECU expects at a given rpm and load; probably shapes the estimated/reported torque, not throttle or boost. This is the full-DAM set, for TGVs open, no EGR (blended by TGV position and EGR amount).

table.name: Engine Torque from Load (DAM 1.0, TGV Open, EGR)
table.description: Engine torque the ECU expects at a given rpm and load; probably shapes the estimated/reported torque, not throttle or boost. This is the full-DAM set, for TGVs open, EGR active (blended by TGV position and EGR amount).

table.name: Engine Torque from Load (DAM 0, TGV Closed)
table.description: Engine torque the ECU expects at a given rpm and load; probably shapes the estimated/reported torque, not throttle or boost. Zero-DAM set (blended with DAM 1.0 by DAM), TGVs closed, no EGR.

table.name: Engine Torque from Load (DAM 0, TGV Closed, EGR)
table.description: Engine torque the ECU expects at a given rpm and load; probably shapes the estimated/reported torque, not throttle or boost. This is the zero-DAM set (blended with DAM 1.0 by DAM), for TGVs closed, EGR active (blended by TGV position and EGR amount).

table.name: Engine Torque from Load (DAM 0, TGV Open)
table.description: Engine torque the ECU expects at a given rpm and load; probably shapes the estimated/reported torque, not throttle or boost. This is the zero-DAM set (blended with DAM 1.0 by DAM), for TGVs open, no EGR (blended by TGV position and EGR amount).

table.name: Engine Torque from Load (DAM 0, TGV Open, EGR)
table.description: Engine torque the ECU expects at a given rpm and load; probably shapes the estimated/reported torque, not throttle or boost. This is the zero-DAM set (blended with DAM 1.0 by DAM), for TGVs open, EGR active (blended by TGV position and EGR amount).

table.name: Full-Load Reference Brake Torque
table.description: Full-load torque by rpm (density corrected) that the throttle/boost model divides every request by. It does not change part-throttle opening; it moves the full-load handover, target MAP and torque limits (raising it lowers target MAP for the same torque). Keep it equal to Throttle Opening Map Reference Torque from 2000 rpm, and edit the (Monitor) copy too.

table.name: Full-Load Reference Brake Torque (Monitor)
table.description: Throttle-monitor copy of Full-Load Reference Brake Torque. Keep identical, or expect the monitor to disagree with the main path (plausibility fault inferred).

table.name: Full-Load Reference Torque Loss
table.description: Engine loss torque by rpm added to Full-Load Reference Brake Torque to give the full-load reference the whole throttle/boost model divides by. Probably a mechanical loss at full load (about the same as Friction and Pumping Torque Loss there). Edit the (Monitor) copy too.

table.name: Full-Load Reference Torque Loss (Monitor)
table.description: Throttle-monitor copy of Full-Load Reference Torque Loss. Keep identical, or expect a plausibility fault (inferred).

table.name: Friction and Pumping Torque Loss
table.description: Friction and pumping losses by rpm and manifold pressure, added to every torque request in the throttle/boost model. Cancels out at part throttle; matters near full load, for the torque estimate and limiters (raising it probably opens the throttle and raises target MAP). Edit the (Monitor) copy too.

table.name: Friction and Pumping Torque Loss (Monitor)
table.description: Throttle-monitor copy of Friction and Pumping Torque Loss. Keep identical, or expect a plausibility fault (inferred).

table.name: Full-Load Reference Torque IAT Factor
table.description: Intake-temperature correction on the full-load reference torque (and on an upper torque ceiling).

table.name: Ignition Efficiency vs Retard
table.description: How much torque the engine loses when timing is retarded from base timing (1.0 = no loss). The torque model uses it, and together with its inverse, Torque Reduction Spark Retard, it also decides how far the fired timing is pulled down toward Primary Ignition plus knock advance. Leave alone, or edit together with its inverse.

table.name: Air Quantity for Torque
table.description: Air quantity needed for a given torque, by rpm; the torque model uses it to judge how much of the requested air has actually arrived (air-path lag), which feeds spark-based torque reduction and the cylinder-cut level. Only the shape matters. Extend the 277 ft-lb (375 Nm) torque axis if your torque request plus losses exceeds it.

table.name: Air Quantity Filter Rate
table.description: Smoothing of the air quantity input to the air-path lag tables (lower = more smoothing).

table.name: Air-Path Lag Rate (Torque Rising)
table.description: How fast the modelled air charge catches up with the request (per 10 ms) during a big rise in torque request (over 74 ft-lb, 100 Nm). Used for spark-based torque reduction and the cylinder-cut level, not for throttle. Leave alone unless you know the model.

table.name: Air-Path Lag Rate (Steady)
table.description: How fast the modelled air charge catches up with the request (per 10 ms) outside a big torque rise. Used for spark-based torque reduction and the cylinder-cut level, not for throttle. Leave alone unless you know the model.

table.name: Torque Response Filter Weight (Throttle Opening)
table.description: How quickly the torque model expects delivered torque to follow after the throttle opens quickly (larger = faster), by rpm. Part of the modelled torque used for spark compensation. Leave alone unless you know the model.

table.name: Torque Response Filter Weight (Throttle Closing)
table.description: How quickly the torque model expects delivered torque to follow after the throttle closes quickly (larger = faster), by rpm. Part of the modelled torque used for spark compensation. Leave alone unless you know the model.

table.name: Torque Delay
table.description: Delay, in half crank revolutions by rpm, used by the torque model's spark compensation when a certain event (not identified) starts. Leave alone.

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier A
table.description: Torque-model smoothing multiplier by coolant (1.0 = normal; very high values mean no smoothing), used for a while after a combustion-mode change while final timing is still well short of the spark target. Leave alone unless you know the model.

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Below Idle Target)
table.description: Version of Torque Model Filter Multiplier A used while rpm is far below the idle target (later software versions).

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier B
table.description: Torque-model smoothing multiplier by coolant (1.0 = normal; very high values mean no smoothing), used in another phase after a combustion-mode change. Leave alone.

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Alt)
table.description: Alternate version of Torque Model Filter Multiplier A, used when an unidentified flag is set. Leave alone unless you know the model.

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Alt, Below Idle Target)
table.description: Version of Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Alt) used while rpm is far below the idle target (later software versions).

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier C (Alt)
table.description: Alternate version of Torque Model Filter Multiplier C, used when an unidentified flag is set. Leave alone.

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier C
table.description: Torque-model smoothing multiplier by coolant (1.0 = normal; very high values mean no smoothing), used after a combustion-mode change until timing reaches the spark target. Leave alone.

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (TGV Closed)
table.description: Version of Torque Model Filter Multiplier A used while the TGVs are closed.

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Below Idle Target, TGV Closed)
table.description: Version of Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (TGV Closed) used while rpm is far below the idle target (later software versions).

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Alt, TGV Closed)
table.description: Version of Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Alt) used while the TGVs are closed.

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Alt, Below Idle Target, TGV Closed)
table.description: Version of Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Alt, TGV Closed) used while rpm is far below the idle target (later software versions).

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier C (Alt, TGV Closed)
table.description: Version of Torque Model Filter Multiplier C (Alt) used while the TGVs are closed.

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier C (TGV Closed)
table.description: Version of Torque Model Filter Multiplier C used while the TGVs are closed.

table.name: Spark Compensation Filter Rate (High Pressure)
table.description: Smoothing of the torque model's spark compensation in one fuel mode near the boost limit. Leave alone.

table.name: Spark Compensation Event Hold Time
table.description: Maximum length of a spark-compensation event in the torque model (the event's trigger is not identified). Leave alone.

table.name: Spark Compensation Event Start Value (Alt)
table.description: Alternate version of Spark Compensation Event Start Value, used when an unidentified flag is set. Leave alone.

table.name: Spark Compensation Event Start Value
table.description: Value the torque model's spark compensation jumps to at the start of an event (the trigger is not identified), by rpm and coolant, before decaying back. Leave alone unless you know the model.

table.name: Spark Compensation Event Initial Hold (Alt)
table.description: Alternate version of Spark Compensation Event Initial Hold, used when an unidentified flag is set. Leave alone.

table.name: Spark Compensation Event Initial Hold
table.description: How long the torque model holds the spark-compensation start value before it begins to decay. Leave alone.

table.name: Spark Compensation Event Decay Step (Alt)
table.description: Alternate version of Spark Compensation Event Decay Step, used when an unidentified flag is set. Leave alone.

table.name: Spark Compensation Event Decay Step
table.description: How fast the spark-compensation event value decays back per 10 ms. Leave alone.

table.name: Spark Air Compensation Limiter
table.description: Limits, by requested amount and coolant, how much the throttle model may add air to make up for retarded spark (TGVs not closed). Large compensation is cut more when cold. Leave alone unless you know the model. On 2017+ ROMs edit the "(Alt)" version instead.

table.name: Spark Air Compensation Limiter (Alt)
table.description: The live version of Spark Air Compensation Limiter on 2017+ ROMs.

table.name: Spark Air Compensation Limiter (TGV Closed)
table.description: Version of Spark Air Compensation Limiter used while the TGVs are closed. On 2017+ ROMs edit the "(Alt)" version instead.

table.name: Spark Air Compensation Limiter (Alt, TGV Closed)
table.description: The live version of Spark Air Compensation Limiter (TGV Closed) on 2017+ ROMs.

table.name: Spark Air Compensation Limiter Baro Factor
table.description: Barometric-pressure factor on Spark Air Compensation Limiter (later software versions).

table.name: Primary Ignition (TGV Closed, AVCS Active)
table.description: Knock-limited ignition timing by rpm and load for TGVs closed while the cams are under AVCS control. With the knock correction advance and fine learning added it forms one side of the timing limit: the ECU fires the lower of this sum and the Base Timing map.

table.name: Primary Ignition (TGV Closed, AVCS Inactive)
table.description: Knock-limited ignition timing by rpm and load for TGVs closed while AVCS is not controlling (start-up, hold or fault), blended in when AVCS drops out. With knock correction advance and fine learning added it forms one side of the timing limit; the ECU fires the lower of this sum and the Base Timing map.

table.name: Primary Ignition (TGV Open, AVCS Active)
table.description: Knock-limited ignition timing by rpm and load for TGVs open while the cams are under AVCS control. With the knock correction advance and fine learning added it forms one side of the timing limit: the ECU fires the lower of this sum and the Base Timing map.

table.name: Primary Ignition (TGV Open, AVCS Inactive)
table.description: Knock-limited ignition timing by rpm and load for TGVs open while AVCS is not controlling (start-up, hold or fault), blended in when AVCS drops out. With knock correction advance and fine learning added it forms one side of the timing limit; the ECU fires the lower of this sum and the Base Timing map.

table.name: Volumetric Efficiency (TGV Closed)
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: Volumetric efficiency by rpm and manifold pressure; feeds the ECU's air-mass model that defines engine load. The ECU blends the TGV Closed and TGV Open tables by actual TGV position. This is the TGVs-closed side. Retune when changing intake, cams or head flow.

table.name: Volumetric Efficiency (TGV Open)
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: Volumetric efficiency by rpm and manifold pressure; feeds the ECU's air-mass model that defines engine load. The ECU blends the TGV Closed and TGV Open tables by actual TGV position. This is the TGVs-open side. Retune when changing intake, cams or head flow.

table.name: Throttle Flow Function
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: Physics curve for airflow through the throttle versus the pressure ratio across it, used by the manifold model that is corrected toward the MAF. Leave alone: it is an exact physical constant.

table.name: Throttle Flow Temperature Correction
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: Temperature correction for throttle airflow in the manifold model (the standard square-root-of-temperature law). Leave alone: it is exact physics.

table.name: Throttle Flow Filter Weight
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: Smoothing of the modelled throttle airflow by pressure ratio: when pressures either side of the throttle are nearly equal (small, noisy flow) it is smoothed more. Normally leave alone.

table.name: Throttle Area from Throttle Position (Airflow Model)
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: Converts throttle position into effective throttle area (mm^2) for the airflow model and the throttle-based MAP substitute; about 2,150 mm^2 wide open.

table.name: Throttle Flow Curve (Area per RPM, MAP Fallback Model)
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: Airflow per revolution versus throttle area per rpm. Used for a throttle-based MAP substitute (probably when the MAP sensor is faulted) and as an input to transient (tip-in) fueling. Change only for a different throttle body.

table.name: Manifold Pressure Rate Span (RPM)
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: How many samples (10 ms each) the ECU spans, by rpm, when measuring how fast manifold pressure is changing; that rate triggers the manifold model's transient corrections.

table.name: Manifold Model Rising Transient Threshold
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: How fast manifold pressure must rise (in gear) to count as a rising transient, which speeds up the ECU's manifold pressure model. Normally leave alone.

table.name: Manifold Model Rising Transient Threshold (Neutral)
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: Version of Manifold Model Rising Transient Threshold used with the transmission in neutral.

table.name: Manifold Model Rising Transient Hysteresis (Neutral)
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: Hysteresis on Manifold Model Rising Transient Threshold (Neutral) once the rising condition is met.

table.name: Manifold Model Gain Multiplier (Falling MAP, Initial)
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: Gain multiplier (1.0 = normal) on the ECU's manifold pressure model when manifold pressure falls quickly: the first phase, for Manifold Model Falling-MAP Initial Duration. Makes the model follow the drop faster. Normally leave alone.

table.name: Manifold Model Gain Multiplier (Falling MAP, Initial, TGV Closed)
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: Gain multiplier (1.0 = normal) on the ECU's manifold pressure model when manifold pressure falls quickly with the TGVs closed: the first phase, for Manifold Model Falling-MAP Initial Duration. Makes the model follow the drop faster. Normally leave alone.

table.name: Manifold Model Gain Multiplier (Falling MAP, Initial, Neutral)
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: Gain multiplier (1.0 = normal) on the ECU's manifold pressure model when manifold pressure falls quickly in neutral: the first phase, for Manifold Model Falling-MAP Initial Duration. Makes the model follow the drop faster. Normally leave alone.

table.name: Manifold Model Gain Multiplier (Falling MAP, Recovery)
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: Gain multiplier (1.0 = normal) on the ECU's manifold pressure model when manifold pressure falls quickly: the recovery phase after the initial phase, until the pressure drop has settled. Normally leave alone.

table.name: Manifold Model Gain Multiplier (Falling MAP, Recovery, TGV Closed)
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: Gain multiplier (1.0 = normal) on the ECU's manifold pressure model when manifold pressure falls quickly with the TGVs closed: the recovery phase after the initial phase, until the pressure drop has settled. Normally leave alone.

table.name: Manifold Model Gain Multiplier (Falling MAP, Recovery, Neutral)
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: Gain multiplier (1.0 = normal) on the ECU's manifold pressure model when manifold pressure falls quickly in neutral: the recovery phase after the initial phase, until the pressure drop has settled. Normally leave alone.

table.name: Manifold Model Falling-MAP Initial Duration
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: How long the manifold model uses the Initial gain multiplier after a quick fall in manifold pressure, before switching to the Recovery multiplier. Normally leave alone.

table.name: Manifold Model Falling-MAP Initial Duration (TGV Closed)
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: How long with the TGVs closed the manifold model uses the Initial gain multiplier after a quick fall in manifold pressure, before switching to the Recovery multiplier. Normally leave alone.

table.name: Manifold Model Falling-MAP Initial Duration (Neutral)
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: How long in neutral the manifold model uses the Initial gain multiplier after a quick fall in manifold pressure, before switching to the Recovery multiplier. Normally leave alone.

table.name: Manifold Model Start Correction RPM Threshold
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: After start, once rpm passes this value (by coolant at start), the manifold model is pulled onto the MAF reading with the start gain (Manifold Model Start Correction MAF Gain) until model and MAF agree. Below this rpm the gain is 1.0. Normally leave alone.

table.name: Manifold Model Start Correction MAF Gain
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: Gain, by coolant at start, on how fast the manifold model is probably pulled onto the MAF reading right after start. Normally leave alone.

table.name: Volumetric Efficiency (AVCS Not Ready)
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description:
VE table that would replace the normal TGV-blended VE while the cams are probably not yet ready.
When that bit is set, 0x11E308 uses this table instead of the Volumetric Efficiency (TGV Closed) / (TGV Open) blend while FFF8A83B bit 7 is clear (read). That bit is an AVCS-ready flag from 0x1050F4 that needs both cam references learned (inferred meaning). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Throttle Flow Coefficient (Forward Flow)
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description: Discharge coefficient of the throttle airflow model for normal flow into the manifold. Leave at 1.0 and describe a new throttle body through the area tables instead.

table.name: Throttle Flow Coefficient (Reverse Flow)
table.category: 05.01 Airflow & Engine Model - Airflow / Load Model
table.description:
Coefficient of the throttle airflow model when the manifold is above the pre-throttle pressure. Leave alone.
Details: When used: every model pass while r > 1.0 (manifold above the pre-throttle pressure; the ratio is inverted). 0x11DD04 (read), enabled by FFF8A8FB bit 0 (0x11E43C): modelled throttle flow FFF8C24C [g/min] = (P_up/101325) x Throttle Flow Function(r) x FFF8ADEC (Throttle Area from Throttle Position, 0.05 mm^2) x Throttle Flow Temperature Correction x this x 60000 x 2.98e-15, which feeds the manifold/airflow observer 0x11DB50 / 0x11D938. Normally leave alone. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Map A (No Enrichment)
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Map A is the fast-reacting part, by rpm and load, used while no open loop enrichment is active. Raising it brings enrichment in earlier; lowering it delays it.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Map A (Enriched)
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Map A is the fast-reacting part, by rpm and load, used while open loop enrichment is active. Raising it brings enrichment in earlier; lowering it delays it.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Map A (Standstill High Load)
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Map A is the fast-reacting part, by rpm and load, used instead of the other Map A tables while the car is at a standstill under high load (speed 5 km/h or less, pedal 80 % or more, load 40 % or more, for 1 s). Raising it brings enrichment in earlier; lowering it delays it.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Map B (No Enrichment)
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Map B is the steady-state value the estimate settles to, by rpm and load, used while no open loop enrichment is active. Raising it brings enrichment in earlier; lowering it delays it.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Map B (Enriched)
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Map B is the steady-state value the estimate settles to, by rpm and load, used while open loop enrichment is active. Raising it brings enrichment in earlier; lowering it delays it.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Map B (Standstill High Load)
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Map B is the steady-state value the estimate settles to, by rpm and load, used while an unidentified speed/pedal/load flag is set. Raising it brings enrichment in earlier; lowering it delays it.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Retard Multiplier A (No Enrichment)
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Multiplies Exhaust Temperature Model Map A (No Enrichment) by timing retard. The Map A part only shapes how the estimate moves while conditions change: it is added through Filter A and taken off again through Filter B, so the settled value depends only on Map B x Retard Multiplier B.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Retard Multiplier A (Enriched)
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Multiplies Exhaust Temperature Model Map A (Enriched) by timing retard. The Map A part only shapes how the estimate moves while conditions change: it is added through Filter A and taken off again through Filter B, so the settled value depends only on Map B x Retard Multiplier B.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Retard Multiplier B (No Enrichment)
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Multiplies Exhaust Temperature Model Map B (No Enrichment) by timing retard: more retard, hotter estimate.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Retard Multiplier B (Enriched)
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Multiplies Exhaust Temperature Model Map B (Enriched) by timing retard: more retard, hotter estimate.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Filter A (Rising)
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. How quickly the Map A part of the estimate follows a rising value (higher = faster).

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Filter A (Falling)
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. How quickly the Map A part of the estimate follows a falling value (higher = faster).

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Filter B (Rising)
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. How quickly the Map B part of the estimate follows a rising value (higher = faster).

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Filter B (Falling)
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. How quickly the Map B part of the estimate follows a falling value (higher = faster).

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Fuel Cut Step
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred): an amount added to the estimate at the start of each fuel cut, by air quantity, which then decays away by Exhaust Temperature Model Fuel Cut Decay.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Fuel Cut Decay
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred): how fast the fuel-cut term from Exhaust Temperature Model Fuel Cut Step decays, by air quantity (1.0 = no decay).

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Map (No Enrichment)
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Second exhaust/catalyst temperature estimate (inferred), by rpm and load, with no enrichment active. When it gets high enough the ECU skips the delay before open loop fueling. Raising it brings open loop in sooner.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Map (Enriched)
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Second exhaust/catalyst temperature estimate (inferred), by rpm and load, while open loop enrichment is active. When it gets high enough the ECU skips the delay before open loop fueling.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Map (Standstill High Load)
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Version of Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Map used while an unidentified flag (based on vehicle speed, pedal and load) is set.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Filter (Rising)
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: How quickly the second exhaust temperature estimate follows a rising value (higher = faster). Normally leave alone.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Filter (Falling)
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: How quickly the second exhaust temperature estimate follows a falling value (higher = faster). Normally leave alone.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Second Filter
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Extra smoothing stage on the second exhaust temperature estimate. Normally leave alone.

table.name: A/F Sensor Exhaust Temp Model Base
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Base exhaust temperature by rpm and load for the A/F sensor's exhaust model, which probably decides when it is safe to heat the front A/F sensor fully (water condensation check). Does not affect fuel or timing.

table.name: A/F Sensor Exhaust Temp Model Timing Factor
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Correction of the A/F sensor exhaust temperature model for ignition timing (later timing = hotter exhaust). Does not affect fuel or timing.

table.name: A/F Sensor Exhaust Temp Model Retard Factor
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Correction of the A/F sensor exhaust temperature model for knock-related retard. Does not affect fuel or timing.

table.name: A/F Sensor Exhaust Temp Model Filter
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: How quickly the A/F sensor exhaust temperature model follows its target, by coolant. Does not affect fuel or timing. Normally leave alone.

table.name: A/F Sensor Exhaust Model Condensate at Start
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Modelled water in the exhaust at start, by coolant and intake temperature. If it is above the threshold, full A/F sensor heating waits until the model has dried out. Raise to delay A/F sensor heating on cold starts, lower to allow it earlier.

table.name: A/F Sensor Exhaust Temp Model Hot Restart Factor
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: On a hot restart, the A/F sensor exhaust model starts from the pipe temperature stored at engine stop, multiplied by this factor by how much the coolant has dropped since. Normally leave alone.

table.name: A/F Sensor Exhaust Model Condensation Flow Factor
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Scales how fast water is modelled to condense in the exhaust, by exhaust flow (probably 1.0 = normal); more condensation keeps the front A/F sensor in its protected heating state longer. Normally leave alone.

table.name: A/F Sensor Exhaust Model Saturation Vapour Pressure
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Water vapour pressure versus exhaust pipe temperature for the A/F sensor condensation model, which decides how long the front A/F sensor is kept in protected heating.

table.name: A/F Sensor Exhaust Temp Model Hot Restart Factor (2D)
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description: Later-software version of A/F Sensor Exhaust Temp Model Hot Restart Factor: on a hot restart the exhaust model starts from the stored pipe temperature times this factor, by stored temperature and coolant drop. Normally leave alone.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Map A Enrichment Adder
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description:
2017+ only: extra amount added to Exhaust Temperature Model Map A (Enriched) while open loop enrichment is active, scaled by how far the enrichment has progressed (inferred).
Details: When used: while open-loop enrichment is active (FFF8ABF4 != 0). 2017+ only. The LF79002P exhaust temperature model adds a signed term in the enriched branch (read, LF79002P decompilation): value = enriched map x retard multiplier / 256 + FFF8ABEE x this(rpm FFF8D3D4, load FFF8AB76)/256. FFF8ABEE = (enrichment FFF8ABF4 - FFF8ABF5) x 256 / (FFF8ABED - FFF8ABF5), clamped 0..255 (0x0DFB18, read), where FFF8ABED comes from 0x0DFA88, the Primary Open Loop Fueling style lookup on the 24 x 20 open-loop grid (0655F8 + 065620 x 065640(DAM) - 065634 x 06560C) - i.e. how far the enrichment has come towards the open-loop target (inferred). The table uses that same 24 x 20 grid (400-9200 rpm x 0.91-2.97 g/rev (70-230 % load)). Same data address in all three images; descriptors placed from the call sites (LF79100P / LF9C100P callsite maps and decompilations, read). LF79002P 0x0D9F80 (counterpart of LF75404S 0x0C9878): added to S = Exhaust Temperature Model Map A (Enriched) 064D64 x Retard Multiplier A (Enriched) 064E78 / 256 (unless FFF8AE27 bit 4 selects the Standstill High Load map). LF79100P: a table LF75404S does not have. Confidence: read.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Map B Enrichment Adder
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description:
2017+ only: extra amount added to Exhaust Temperature Model Map B (Enriched) while open loop enrichment is active, scaled by how far the enrichment has progressed (inferred).
Details: When used: while open-loop enrichment is active (FFF8ABF4 != 0). 2017+ only. The LF79002P exhaust temperature model adds a signed term in the enriched branch (read, LF79002P decompilation): value = enriched map x retard multiplier / 256 + FFF8ABEE x this(rpm FFF8D3D4, load FFF8AB76)/256. FFF8ABEE = (enrichment FFF8ABF4 - FFF8ABF5) x 256 / (FFF8ABED - FFF8ABF5), clamped 0..255 (0x0DFB18, read), where FFF8ABED comes from 0x0DFA88, the Primary Open Loop Fueling style lookup on the 24 x 20 open-loop grid (0655F8 + 065620 x 065640(DAM) - 065634 x 06560C) - i.e. how far the enrichment has come towards the open-loop target (inferred). The table uses that same 24 x 20 grid (400-9200 rpm x 0.91-2.97 g/rev (70-230 % load)). Same data address in all three images; descriptors placed from the call sites (LF79100P / LF9C100P callsite maps and decompilations, read). LF79002P 0x0D9F80: added to U = Exhaust Temperature Model Map B (Enriched) 064E04 x Retard Multiplier B (Enriched) 064E54 / 256 (unless FFF8AE27 bit 4 selects the Standstill High Load map). LF79100P: a table LF75404S does not have. Confidence: read.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Enrichment Adder
table.category: 05.02 Airflow & Engine Model - Exhaust & Temperature Models
table.description:
2017+ only: extra amount added to the second exhaust temperature estimate while open loop enrichment is active, scaled by how far the enrichment has progressed (inferred).
Details: When used: while open-loop enrichment is active (FFF8ABF4 != 0) and FFF8AE27 bit 4 is clear. 2017+ only. The LF79002P exhaust temperature model adds a signed term in the enriched branch (read, LF79002P decompilation): value = enriched map x retard multiplier / 256 + FFF8ABEE x this(rpm FFF8D3D4, load FFF8AB76)/256. FFF8ABEE = (enrichment FFF8ABF4 - FFF8ABF5) x 256 / (FFF8ABED - FFF8ABF5), clamped 0..255 (0x0DFB18, read), where FFF8ABED comes from 0x0DFA88, the Primary Open Loop Fueling style lookup on the 24 x 20 open-loop grid (0655F8 + 065620 x 065640(DAM) - 065634 x 06560C) - i.e. how far the enrichment has come towards the open-loop target (inferred). The table uses that same 24 x 20 grid (400-9200 rpm x 0.91-2.97 g/rev (70-230 % load)). Same data address in all three images; descriptors placed from the call sites (LF79100P / LF9C100P callsite maps and decompilations, read). LF79002P 0x0D8F60 (counterpart of LF75404S 0x0C965C): added to Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Map (Enriched) 064A0C x Retard Multiplier 064AAC / 256. LF79100P: a table LF75404S does not have. Confidence: read.

table.name: Intake Cam Target 1A (TGV Open, Normal, Altitude)
table.description: Intake cam advance target (degrees from the fully retarded rest position) by rpm and load for normal driving with the TGVs open, used at altitude (blended in by AVCS Barometric Blend; near sea level the 1B table is used instead). Higher = earlier intake valve timing. The normal vs high-pedal split is inferred from the switching conditions.

table.name: Intake Cam Target 1B (TGV Open, Normal, Sea Level)
table.description: Main intake cam advance target (degrees from rest) by rpm and load for normal driving with the TGVs open near sea level: above light part throttle, above about 5200 rpm, or cold. Higher = earlier intake timing. At light part throttle the TGVs close and Intake Cam Target 3B is used instead. Normal vs high-pedal split is inferred.

table.name: Intake Cam Target 2A (TGV Open, High Pedal, Altitude)
table.description: Intake cam advance target (degrees from rest) by rpm and load used when the pedal is near wide open (about 90 % or more), TGVs open, at altitude. Higher = earlier intake timing. The high-pedal meaning is inferred from the switching conditions.

table.name: Intake Cam Target 2B (TGV Open, High Pedal, Sea Level)
table.description: Intake cam advance target (degrees from rest) by rpm and load used when the pedal is near wide open (about 90 % or more), TGVs open, near sea level. This, not 1B, sets wide-open-throttle intake timing near sea level. Higher = earlier intake timing. The high-pedal meaning is inferred from the switching conditions.

table.name: Intake Cam Target 3A (TGV Closed, Altitude)
table.description: Intake cam advance target (degrees from rest) by rpm and load used while the TGVs are closed (light part throttle), at altitude. Higher = earlier intake timing. Near sea level Intake Cam Target 3B is used instead.

table.name: Intake Cam Target 3B (TGV Closed, Sea Level)
table.description: Intake cam advance target (degrees from rest) by rpm and load used while the TGVs are closed (light part throttle, cruising) near sea level. Higher = earlier intake timing. This is the table that sets light-load intake timing on most cars.

table.name: Intake Cam Target Limit
table.description: Ceiling on the intake cam target by rpm and load, only in some software versions. It applies while a condition flag (not identified) is set and ramps back up when it clears; Intake Cam Target Limit Temperature Offset x Factor adjust it by a temperature.

table.name: Intake Cam Target Limit Temperature Offset
table.description: Amount added to Intake Cam Target Limit by rpm and load, scaled by Intake Cam Target Limit Temperature Factor.

table.name: Intake Cam Target Limit Temperature Factor
table.description: Scales Intake Cam Target Limit Temperature Offset by a temperature input that is not identified (1.0 = the full offset).

table.name: Intake Cam Coolant Offset A (Altitude)
table.description: Extra intake cam advance (degrees) added to the final intake cam target at altitude (whatever the TGV state), scaled by Intake Cam Coolant Factor so it can act only when cold. Positive = more advance.

table.name: Intake Cam Coolant Offset 2A (High Pedal, Altitude)
table.description: Extra intake cam advance (degrees, scaled by the intake coolant factor) added to the high-pedal (near wide-open) TGV-open target at altitude. Not present in the 2015/2016 builds.

table.name: Intake Cam Coolant Offset 3A (TGV Closed, Altitude)
table.description: Extra intake cam advance (degrees, scaled by the intake coolant factor) added to the TGV-closed target at altitude. Not present in the 2015/2016 builds.

table.name: Intake Cam Coolant Offset B (Sea Level)
table.description: Extra intake cam advance (degrees) added to the final intake cam target near sea level (whatever the TGV state; with the TGVs closed it adds on top of Intake Cam Coolant Offset 3B), scaled by Intake Cam Coolant Factor so it can act only when cold. Positive = more advance.

table.name: Intake Cam Coolant Offset 2B (High Pedal, Sea Level)
table.description: Extra intake cam advance (degrees, scaled by the intake coolant factor) added to the high-pedal (near wide-open) TGV-open target at sea level. Not present in the 2015/2016 builds.

table.name: Intake Cam Coolant Offset 3B
table.description: Extra intake cam advance (degrees) added to Intake Cam Target 3B (TGVs closed, sea level), scaled by Intake Cam Coolant Factor 3 so it can act only when cold. Positive = more advance.

table.name: Intake Cam Coolant Factor
table.description: Multiplier (128 = 1.0) by coolant temperature on Intake Cam Coolant Offset A (Altitude) and B (Sea Level), the cold-engine corrections for the normal TGV-open cam targets.

table.name: Intake Cam Coolant Factor 3
table.description: Multiplier (128 = 1.0) by coolant temperature on Intake Cam Coolant Offset 3B, the cold-engine correction for the TGV-closed sea-level intake cam target.

table.name: Intake Cam Target Ceiling (Oil Temp Low, breakpoint 0x496BD)
table.description: Upper limit on the final intake cam target, interpolated by (probably) oil temperature between the Low / Mid / High ceiling tables.

table.name: Intake Cam Target Ceiling (Oil Temp Mid, breakpoint 0x496BE)
table.description: Upper limit on the final intake cam target, interpolated by (probably) oil temperature between the Low / Mid / High ceiling tables.

table.name: Intake Cam Target Ceiling (Oil Temp High, breakpoint 0x496BC)
table.description: Upper limit on the final intake cam target, interpolated by (probably) oil temperature between the Low / Mid / High ceiling tables.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Target 1A (TGV Open, Normal, Altitude)
table.description: Exhaust cam retard target (degrees from the fully advanced rest position) by rpm and load for normal driving with the TGVs open, at altitude (near sea level 1B is used). Higher = later exhaust closing and more overlap. The normal vs high-pedal split is inferred.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Target 1B (TGV Open, Normal, Sea Level)
table.description: Main exhaust cam retard target (degrees from rest) by rpm and load for normal driving with the TGVs open near sea level. Higher = later exhaust closing and more valve overlap. At light part throttle the TGVs close and Exhaust Cam Target 3B is used instead. Normal vs high-pedal split is inferred.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Target 2A (TGV Open, High Pedal, Altitude)
table.description: Exhaust cam retard target (degrees from rest) by rpm and load used when the pedal is near wide open (about 90 % or more), TGVs open, at altitude. Higher = more overlap. The high-pedal meaning is inferred from the switching conditions.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Target 2B (TGV Open, High Pedal, Sea Level)
table.description: Exhaust cam retard target (degrees from rest) by rpm and load used when the pedal is near wide open (about 90 % or more), TGVs open, near sea level. Higher = more overlap. High-pedal meaning inferred.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Target 3A (TGV Closed, Altitude)
table.description: Exhaust cam retard target (degrees from rest) by rpm and load while the TGVs are closed (light part throttle), at altitude. Higher = more overlap. Near sea level Exhaust Cam Target 3B is used instead.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Target 3B (TGV Closed, Sea Level)
table.description: Exhaust cam retard target (degrees from rest) by rpm and load while the TGVs are closed (light part throttle, cruising) near sea level. Higher = later exhaust closing and more overlap (internal EGR).

table.name: Exhaust Cam Coolant Offset A (Altitude)
table.description: Cold-engine correction (degrees of exhaust retard) added to the final exhaust cam target at altitude (whatever the TGV state), scaled by Exhaust Cam Coolant Factor. Positive = more retard.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Coolant Offset 2A (High Pedal, Altitude)
table.description: Extra exhaust cam retard (degrees, scaled by the exhaust coolant factor) added to the high-pedal (near wide-open) TGV-open target at altitude. Not present in the 2015/2016 builds.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Coolant Offset 3A (TGV Closed, Altitude)
table.description: Extra exhaust cam retard (degrees, scaled by the exhaust coolant factor) added to the TGV-closed target at altitude. Not present in the 2015/2016 builds.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Coolant Offset B (Sea Level)
table.description: Cold-engine correction (degrees of exhaust retard) added to the final exhaust cam target near sea level, scaled by Exhaust Cam Coolant Factor. It applies whatever the TGV state: with the TGVs closed it adds on top of Exhaust Cam Coolant Offset 3B.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Coolant Offset 2B (High Pedal, Sea Level)
table.description: Extra exhaust cam retard (degrees, scaled by the exhaust coolant factor) added to the high-pedal (near wide-open) TGV-open target at sea level. Not present in the 2015/2016 builds.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Coolant Offset 3B
table.description: Cold-engine correction (degrees of exhaust retard) added to Exhaust Cam Target 3B (TGVs closed, sea level), scaled by Exhaust Cam Coolant Factor 3. Exhaust Cam Coolant Offset B is added on top of it in all TGV states, so with the TGVs closed both act.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Coolant Factor
table.description: Multiplier (128 = 1.0) by coolant temperature on Exhaust Cam Coolant Offset A (Altitude) and B (Sea Level), so those cold-engine exhaust cam corrections (applied in every TGV state) fade in or out with temperature.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Coolant Factor 3
table.description: Multiplier (128 = 1.0) by coolant temperature on Exhaust Cam Coolant Offset 3B, the cold-engine correction for the TGV-closed sea-level exhaust cam target.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Target Ceiling (Oil Temp Low, breakpoint 0x496C5)
table.description: Upper limit on the final exhaust cam target, interpolated by (probably) oil temperature between the Low / Mid / High ceiling tables.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Target Ceiling (Oil Temp Mid, breakpoint 0x496C6)
table.description: Upper limit on the final exhaust cam target, interpolated by (probably) oil temperature between the Low / Mid / High ceiling tables.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Target Ceiling (Oil Temp High, breakpoint 0x496C4)
